sections.label: Cybersecurity & Secure Systems
sections.summary: A focused view of security controls in existing projects: SQL access restrictions, container hardening and private network design.
sections.skills: Access restrictions · Container hardening · Network isolation
sections.note: These three projects are also listed under AI & ML Engineering or Cloud & DevOps. This section highlights their implemented security controls; it does not count them as additional projects or claim a standalone penetration-testing portfolio.

projects.name: LinkScope
projects.problem: URL shortener with campaign analytics
features: Custom aliases, expiry and link disabling
verification_limits: Counts describe visits, not unique people. The local application has no authenticated management or public anti-abuse service.

projects.name: NoteMesh
projects.problem: Shared meeting notes without lost edits
features: Revision checks and preserved conflict drafts
verification_limits: Synchronization happens when a whole note is saved. There is no character-by-character collaborative merge. Room names are not authentication.

projects.name: Repo Radar
projects.problem: Understand public repository activity
features: Live GitHub snapshots with bounded pagination
Five-minute cache and dated activity charts
verification_limits: API rate limits and network availability affect live mode. A commit count is not a measure of developer performance or complete repository history.

projects.name: TabHarbor
projects.problem: Organize crowded browser sessions
features: Domain-based tab groups and duplicate preview
Saved workspaces and restore in a new window
verification_limits: Verified with bundled Chromium on Linux CI; Chrome Web Store publication is not included.
The extension has not been published in the Chrome Web Store. Workspaces save URLs, not login sessions or browsing history. Saved URLs are not encrypted.

projects.name: Upstream Lab
projects.problem: Reproduce and improve an open-source behavior
verification_limits: No upstream pull request has been submitted or accepted. The reproducer deliberately stops if its existing var/upstream checkout is already modified.

projects.name: PayLens
projects.problem: Explore salary estimates and uncertainty
features: Synthetic salary regression with a median baseline
Separate training, calibration and test splits
verification_limits: These results describe authored synthetic data. They are not reliable market salary estimates or a guarantee about any individual’s compensation.

projects.name: Retention Studio
projects.problem: Prioritize reviewable churn retention work
features: Calibrated churn scores and eligibility rules
verification_limits: The data is fictional and the labels are historical. A high churn score does not prove that outreach will prevent churn. Numerical runtime warnings occurred in the recorded macOS test environment.

projects.name: CourtCraft
projects.problem: Compare basketball performance fairly
verification_limits: The dataset does not describe a real league. Rates and model intervals do not account for every factor, such as opponent strength, pace or team role.

projects.name: Ticket Tuner
projects.problem: Adapt a small model for support routing
verification_limits: Large trained weights are excluded from Git. A fresh clone needs the pinned base-model download and training. A perfect score on limited synthetic examples does not establish real-world support accuracy.

projects.name: SpendMap
projects.problem: Understand spending with editable categories
features: Editable merchant rules and exact spending totals
Monthly summaries and normalized customer features
verification_limits: The transactions are synthetic. Clusters are descriptive and depend on the rules and selected features; they are not financial advice.

projects.name: DocSearch Atlas
projects.problem: Answer engineering runbook questions with evidence
features: Optional local FLAN inference and no-evidence responses
verification_limits: Retrieval is lexical, so paraphrases without shared words may be missed. Generated answers can be wrong even when citations are displayed.

projects.name: QueryGuard
projects.problem: Ask bounded sales questions safely
verification_limits: This is a bounded rules-based interface over synthetic data. It does not use a language model to generate arbitrary SQL.

projects.name: Release Pilot
projects.problem: Assemble a release review from local changes
features: Allowlisted local inspection and test workflow
Passing-test gate, content cache and audit records
Optional local-model summaries with guarded fallback
verification_limits: The tool cannot send, tag, push or deploy a release. The summary guard is conservative but does not guarantee semantic truth; the result is for human review.

projects.name: EvalBench
projects.problem: Compare model answers using repeatable evidence
features: Actual direct and context-assisted FLAN runs
Paired bootstrap intervals and case-by-case inspection
projects.data: Authored QA cases; explicit recorded responses
verification_limits: The small authored set cannot establish general superiority. Token overlap measures agreement with reference text, not guaranteed factual correctness.

projects.name: ShelfMatch
projects.problem: Find material swatches using text and image features
features: Text similarity and color/texture image features
Adjustable modality weights and ranked gallery
verification_limits: This is an interpretable feature baseline, not a pretrained vision-language model. Images are procedural swatches; queries use catalog references rather than arbitrary uploads.

projects.name: Shipyard
projects.problem: Ship a health-checked service through CI
features: Container build and delivery through GitHub Actions
verification_limits: Actual temporary CI container verified; no continuously hosted public service or production rollout.
The deployment target is a temporary CI container or local Compose service. Continuous public hosting, registry delivery and zero-downtime production rollout are outside this scope.

projects.name: Network Foundry
projects.problem: Reproduce a segmented AWS network safely
features: Terraform private network and endpoint configuration
verification_limits: No AWS resources deployed; only configuration, Python and mock-provider checks executed.
No AWS resources were deployed. These checks cannot prove live packet delivery or account-specific IAM behavior. Terraform apply would require a separate cost and account review.

projects.name: CostCompass
projects.problem: Explain AWS cost drivers and review opportunities
verification_limits: No real AWS account is connected. The data is synthetic and the app makes no infrastructure changes or automatic spending decisions.

projects.name: Failover Forge
projects.problem: Measure local recovery under service failure
features: Two real local HTTP service processes
Primary failure, client fallback and restart
Measured recovery sequence and process cleanup
verification_limits: This is a same-host, stateless process experiment. It is not a multi-region system, load balancer or data-replication test; no recovery-point objective was measured.

projects.name: Scale Lab
projects.problem: Understand autoscaling under measured load
features: Kubernetes probes, resource requests and HPA
verification_limits: Actual kind cluster scaled from two to six available replicas; multi-node production operation and scale-down benchmarks are outside scope.
The calculator simplifies controller behavior. The real test uses a disposable single-node cluster; scale-down timing, node autoscaling and production capacity were not benchmarked.

projects.name: Margin Ledger
projects.problem: Find product and return patterns with SQL
features: Eight SQL reports at order-line grain
Return reversals and exact money calculations
Consistent totals and a business-results report
verification_limits: The business data is synthetic. Shipping, tax and processing fees are excluded. Descriptive patterns do not establish why real customers behave a certain way.

projects.name: JourneyMark
projects.problem: Compare marketing attribution assumptions
features: First-touch, last-touch, linear and time-decay models
verification_limits: Attribution describes a chosen credit rule. It does not prove a channel caused a purchase or measure incremental advertising return.

projects.name: Retail Control Tower
projects.problem: Explore retail revenue, profit and delivery performance
features: Interactive revenue, profit and delivery dashboard
Distinct-order delivery metrics and safe-field selection
verification_limits: The finished scope is the synthetic-data browser dashboard. The preserved optional forecasting pipeline, native Power BI work and real-source Kaggle analysis were not revalidated as completed deliverables.

projects.name: Experiment Lens
projects.problem: Audit and interpret an A/B experiment
features: Conversion intervals, lift and significance testing
verification_limits: This is a fixed-horizon normal-approximation analysis. Sparse outcomes, repeated peeking, multiple comparisons and causal validity beyond the experiment design need additional work.

projects.name: Energy Brief
projects.problem: Research electricity generation trends reproducibly
features: Source checksums and a reproducible research report
projects.data: Our World in Data energy data / cited upstream
verification_limits: The six countries are an illustrative selection. These historical comparisons do not isolate policy effects or provide forecasts.

projects.name: Global Health Passport
projects.problem: Synthetic health workflows across Java, React and Expo
features: Shared backend for web and mobile clients
verification_limits: Synthetic prototype; no live patient deployment or compliance certification.

projects.name: Durable Queue
projects.problem: Persistent SQLite jobs with leases, retries and recovery
features: Retries, dead letters and idempotent enqueue
verification_limits: Single-host queue with at-least-once delivery; external side effects still require idempotency.

projects.name: Contract Pipeline
projects.problem: Contract-driven CSV ingestion with validation and replay protection
verification_limits: Local ingestion demonstration; no managed cloud data platform.
